items.title: Deadline to file Widerspruch against the Unterhaltsvorschuss decision
items.quote: Er muss innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe des Bescheids bei uns eingehen (Kreisverwaltung Musterhunsrück, Schlossplatz 7, 55469 Musterbach im Hunsrück); Sie können ihn schriftlich einreichen oder bei uns zur Niederschrift erklären.
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 19.11.2026; letter itself states the Bekanntgabefiktion: 'gilt am vierten Tag nach seiner Aufgabe zur Post als bekannt gegeben'. Posting day = 19.11.2026 (no separate 'Tag der Aufgabe zur Post' given, so letter date used). Counting 4 calendar days: 20.11 (Fri)=1, 21.11 (Sat)=2, 22.11 (Sun)=3, 23.11 (Mon)=4 → deemed delivery = Mon 23.11.2026. This is a non-tax authority (Jugendamt/Kreisverwaltung, Widerspruch under § 84 SGG / § 37 SGB X regime); the 4th day already falls on a weekday (Monday), so no weekend-shift issue arises for the delivery day. One-month Widerspruch period under § 187 Abs.1, § 188 Abs.2 BGB: delivery day (23.11.) not counted, period ends on the day with the same number one month later = 23.12.2026. Check if 23.12.2026 (a Wednesday) is a Sunday/Saturday/public holiday in RP: it is not (Christmas Day 25.12. is a Friday, so 23.12. is unaffected). No adjustment needed.

items.title: Immediately report if the father pays maintenance or if you move
items.quote: Teilen Sie uns bitte sofort mit, wenn er Unterhalt an Sie zahlt oder Sie umziehen.
items.computation: The letter requires immediate ('sofort') notification whenever either triggering event occurs (payment by the father, or a change of address). No calendar date or counted period is given, and the trigger events themselves are of unknown future date, so no fixed due_date can be computed; this is an ongoing/conditional reporting duty rather than a one-time deadline.

warnings: The reporting obligation to notify the authority 'sofort' (immediately) about maintenance payments received or a change of address has no fixed calendar date; it is a standing duty triggered by future events and was left without a due_date.
